messages:
ana (People Ops): Quick PSA — final day for performance review submissions. If you have last-minute feedback, evidence, or attachments that didn't get into the review form, we can triage them until 17:00 PT today. Please follow the filename and approval rules below before uploading. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mark (Eng Manager): Thanks — two of my ICs had feedback captured in Google Docs but I missed attaching before the cutoff. Can I still send?

ana (People Ops): @mark yes — send the docs and a short manager confirmation note. We need manager signoff to accept post-deadline items. Uploads without manager confirmation will be rejected.

mark (Eng Manager): Got it. What's the exact upload destination and file naming pattern?

jess (People Ops): Upload here: https://internal.redwood.com/review-uploads (S3-backed form). Use this exact filename convention so our intake script picks it up:

```
Filename: REVIEW_<lastname>_<YYYYMMDD>_<mgrInitials>.<ext>
Example: REVIEW_Gupta_20260728_MK.pdf
Required metadata in the top of the document: reviewer_name | manager_name | upload_timestamp | short_context (1-2 lines)
```

sam (Manager): If I paste inline feedback instead of a PDF, is that acceptable or do you need a file?

ana (People Ops): Either is fine. If pasting inline, put the feedback under a heading `POST-DEADLINE FEEDBACK` and include manager signoff as a one-line confirmation. Best practice: attach a PDF or export to PDF to preserve formatting.

mark (Eng Manager): Uploaded both docs and left a note here: "Manager confirmed, late upload due to timezone coordination". The upload form returned a receipt id 8a3f-cc21.

review-bot: upload received: receipt 8a3f-cc21 for REVIEW_Gupta_20260728_MK.pdf — queued for manual triage.

jess (People Ops): @mark thanks — I see it in the queue. We will evaluate for calibration and flag anything that needs escalation. If any edits are needed we’ll ping you.

mark (Eng Manager): Appreciate it. Two quick clarifications: 1) will late uploads be incorporated into calibration pools? 2) do they affect distribution-based rating adjustments?

ana (People Ops): 1) Yes, if received before 17:00 PT and with manager signoff we'll include them in calibration. 2) They will be treated the same as on-time submissions during calibration, but any very late exceptions (beyond the triage window) will require exception approval from HR lead.

sam (Manager): I have one case where peer feedback arrived after the cutoff but the manager already had it summarized. I attached the peer notes and manager summary — is that okay?

jess (People Ops): That’s fine. Please ensure the peer feedback source is cited (names or summary) and that the manager summary includes the key quotes and impact. We prefer anonymized excerpts if peers asked for privacy, but still need a manager statement that they reviewed originals.

mark (Eng Manager): Small nit — can the intake form return a timestamp in UTC? Helps me track across EMEA.

review-bot: upload received: receipt 8a3f-cc22 for REVIEW_Sanchez_20260728_MK.pdf — timestamp 2026-07-28T00:32:10Z

ana (People Ops): We're adding UTC timestamps to receipts now — should show up for any new uploads in the next 15 min.

jess (People Ops): Quick reminder: we can't accept new raw review form submissions after 17:00 PT; only attachments/evidence via the triage flow. If you have someone on LOA or timezone exceptions, ping me directly and we'll route to the exceptions queue.

mark (Eng Manager): Understood. Thanks team.

ana (People Ops): Thanks everyone — if you're uploading, please do it as soon as possible. We'll post a final confirmation in this thread once the triage queue is cleared. :white_check_mark:
